about: Every shared block under packs/ and tool-library/: a family is the name in its BEGIN/END markers (`# BEGIN SHARED X` ... `# END SHARED X`, or the dashed `# ---- BEGIN X ----` ... `# ---- END X ----`), a variant is one text of it (the lines strictly between the markers, digested), carriers is how many files hold that text, example is one of them. The first variant of a family is its base; every other variant says why it exists. tests/shared-blocks-census.test.ts fails on a family or a variant that is not declared here, on a changed number of carriers, and on a BEGIN without its END. When a sweep or an adoption adds or removes carriers, change `carriers` in the same change; when a new variant is meant, add it with its reason. A block that changes everywhere at once needs no edit here (the file declares counts, not digests).
lossless_page: Recommendation on `LosslessPage` (not marked, converted or counted here): the class is in 67 files in several textual variants, and the largest group, the windows pack's tools and their tool-library twins, carries one text (slice it as tests/tool-library.test.ts does, from `class LosslessPage` to its `return result`). It is a block in every sense but the markers. Recommendation: mark it as a block (`# BEGIN SHARED LOSSLESS PAGE`) in the windows lineage first, where the text is already one, declare that family here, and leave the other variants unmarked until each pack's own package converges its pager; do not mark all 67 at once, because the PAGE block and NoReplacePage already sit beside it in the same files and a sweep of the class would be one more writer on them. The owner decides.
